name: Puig Brands SA
summary: Puig Brands S.A. functions as a holding entity primarily involved in the production and distribution of perfumes, apparel, and cosmetic items. Its operations are organized into three principal divisions: Fragrance and Fashion, Make-up, and Skincare. The Fragrance and Fashion division is dedicated to the development, promotion, and retailing of scents, alongside clothing lines, accessories, and various other fashion goods. Within the Make-up category, the company provides a range of cosmetics such as foundations, concealers, lipsticks, glosses, eyeliners, blushes, mascaras, and eyeshadows. Its Skincare offerings encompass cleansers, toners, moisturizers, serums, body treatments, exfoliants, solutions for acne and oil control, facial masks, and sun protection items. Established by Antonio Puig Castelló in 1914, this enterprise maintains its corporate headquarters in Barcelona, Spain.
